tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings mkha' la snying rje'i chu 'dzin gyis// drag sngags dbyar rnga'i rol pa phrin las kyi// glog phreng rdo rje'i me char cher phab pas// log 'dren 'joms byed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdigs nag po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba'i rim pa ni/ sman raka gtor mchod sogs skabs su bab pa'i yo byad 'du bya zhing bsham tshul sogs bla ma gong ma'i man ngag dang mthong rgyud ltar bkod legs par byas te/ bdag nyid stan bde bar kha lhor phyogs pas 'dug ste/ phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa'i tshul la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la'ang*/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ bka' bsgo/ mtshams gcod/ dam bca'/ bshags pa/ mchod pa dang sman raka gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa dang bdun no// dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs kun 'dus zil gnon bcom ldan 'das// 'jam dpal khros pa tshe bdag yab yum sras// 'khor bcas rang rig snang ba'i lha tshogs la/ */byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// zhes gsum dang*/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs log par lta ba tshar gcod cing*// 'gro rnams dag pa'i sa la rab 'god phyir// dus 'di nas bzung bla med byang chub bar// smon 'jug don dam byang chub mchog sems bskyed// ces gsum brjod/ gsum pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor chung gnyis gzhi bdag dang bgegs la spyi 'gro ltar byin la/ e/ yang gsang zil gnon gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du// dam ldan 'du ba'i rigs rnams ma gtogs pa// skal med log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs// lan chags gtor ma ting lo chang bur bcas// 'dod yon rgya chen longs spyod 'di khyer la// gnas 'dir ma 'dug rang rang gnas su song*// gal te mi 'gro gnas 'dir 'dug gyur na// bdag nyid 'jam dpal khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// bgegs rnams brlag cing sreg par gdon mi za// de bas bka' las ma 'da' myur du dengs| |zhes hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/

bzhi pa mtshams gcod cing srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ bdag nyid zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pa bsgoms la/ e/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yang gsang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang med// chos nyid ngang du mtshams bcad do// bdag nyid zil gnon thugs ka nas// e laṃ baṃ raṃ yaṃ 'phros pas// phyi nas rim bzhin nam mkha' dang*// sa chu me rlung gur khang 'khrigs// slar yang thugs las 'khor lo dang*// ral gri rdo rje be con dang*// gtun shing la sogs mtshon cha'i tshogs// 'phros pas de yi gur du gyur// slar yang thugs nas āḥhrīḥtrāṃ// hūm̐ dang oṃ rnams 'phros pa las// ljang dmar ser dang mthing dkar gyi// khro chen rgya gram pad+ma dang*// rin chen rdo rje 'khor lo'i tshogs// bsnams pa phyi nas rim bzhin du// bar med gang ba'i gur khang dbus// ā di kā di las grub pa'i// byang chen mchod rten bum nang du// bdag nyid bum nang skur gyur pas// bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang med// rgya la srid na'ang rdul du rlogs// oṃ ya ma rā dza kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes gsal gdab/ lnga pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas// 'gro rnams rgyal ba'i go 'phang la 'god cing*// dgra bgegs log par lta ba tshar gcod phyir// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' sdud srung zlog bsad// mnan sreg 'phang dang gshed bzhi'i sbyor ba dang*// ur mo'i las dang spyang mo drug la sogs// yang gsang sdig pa'i lam bzang ji snyed pa| |deng nas byang chub sa la ma bzhag par// srog la bab kyang mi gtong bsgrub par bya// ma hā sa ma ya a aḥ drug pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ bshags yul bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab la/ hoḥ bla ma mchog dang 'jam dpal khro bo'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs// ma rig dbang gyur mi dge bcu spyad cing*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa dang*// ma 'byor nyams shing rnam g.yeng dbang gyur pas// gsang sngags chos tshul 'chal zhing 'dres pa dang*// log par lta rnams dus su ma bsgral sogs// lha mchog khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba rnams// bzod par 'bul lo tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// mthol yang mi dgongs bshags kyang mi tshangs na// dam can khyod kyi sgrib par mi 'gyur ram// de bas mthol bshags bzod pa myur bzhes la// tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ces dang*/

oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bdun pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni| oṃ/ ar+ghaṃ dkar mos mchod yon thogs// pā d+yaṃ ser mos zhabs bsil 'dzin// puṣ+pe dkar mos me tog thogs// dhū pe dmar mos spos snod 'chang*// ā lo ke dmar snang gsal thogs| |gan+dhe ljang khus dri chab 'dzin// nai wi d+ye dkar bshos gtsang 'dzin// shapad khra mos rol mo ldir// gzhan yang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i nang mchod lnga// yab yum sbyar ba'i gsang mchod bde ba che// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman gyis mchod// rgyu rkyen rab sbyar rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs// brjid ldan ba liṃ gtor tshogs ri ltar spungs// dngos sbyor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// sgrub mchog bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la// dbang bskur byin phob smin grol dngos grub stsol// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pū dza a nu rā ga ya a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ba ling+ta pū dza ya ma rā dza s+ya dzñā na a dhiṣ+ṭhān ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra/ tsa la ya/ a a aḥ zhes brjod do// de rnams sngon 'gro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ting 'dzin gsum dang gzhal yas khang*/ lha bskyed pa/ spyan drang ba/ bzhugs gsol/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ dam tshig gsol ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ sman mchod/ rak+ta/ gtor ma/ phrin las bcol ba/ bstod pa/ 'dzab bzla ba dang bco brgyad do// dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ e/ chos sku rang bzhin stong gsal chos kyi dbyings// tha snyad kun bral byang chub sems kyi ngang*// dmigs med yul kun ngang gi bde ba'i don// yongs su dag pa chu zla lta bu nyid// ye shes 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rang shar ba'o// oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa dharma dhā tu dzñā na sa mā dhi swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

yod med mtha' bral hūm̐ mthing cho 'phrul las// e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ keṃ bh+rūṃ hūm̐ las| |rgyud lnga yongs dag stong nyid nam mkha'i dbus// phrag dog rlung nag zhe sdang rngam pa'i me// 'dod chags khrag mtsho gti mug zhing chen nyil// keng rus ri rab rdo rje'i dra gur dang*| |bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong*// skye 'gag mtha' bral gzhal yas khang du gyur// gnyis pa pho brang bskyed pa ni/ bh+rūṃ yig las byung dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// mi mgo skam rlon nem gsum brtsegs pa las// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi bzhis mdzes// don snying rnam lnga'i dra ba dra phyed 'chang*// rin chen du ma'i pha gus rab mdzes shing*// rkang lag lhu dum myos zung tshar du dngar// zhing chen ka ba zhing lpags ka rgyan can// sbrul nag chun po 'dod snam phyogs bzhir bstar// rtsibs ma'i dral lcam tsit+ta'i tog gis spras// khrag chen gsum dang dug gis rab sbags pa'i// dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas chen po'i mthar// rab 'jigs bsrung ba'i gur dang dur khrod brgyad// ye shes lnga ldan me dpung 'bar bas bskor// de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i mthar// 'khor rtsibs brgyad dang de'i mthar bcu gnyis rtsibs// de'i phyir 'obs chen bco brgyad kyis bskor ba'i// 'khor lo'i lte bar chos kyi 'byung gnas nyid// mthing nag 'bar ba rngam zhing brjid ldan gyur// ces bskyed// gsum pa lha bskyed pa ni/ e/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte ba gru gsum dbus// mthong ba'i dug chen klu 'bum sbrul gyi tshul| |de'i steng gnyan khri lcong mo'i tshul du gnas// de'i steng sa bdag sbal nag stong gi tshogs// dregs pa bco brgyad de'i steng sde brgyad tshogs// de'i steng rgyal po chen po sde bzhi po// brgya byin gshin rje klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs// dbang ldan me lha srin po rlung gi lha// nyi zla la sogs phyogs skyong bcu rnams kyang*// rin chen rgyan ldan gan rkyal 'dug pa'i steng*// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i dbus// ma he sngon po rin chen rgyan ldan brgyad// gshibs pa'i steng du rin chen pad sdong rtser// nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar steng*// rgyu yi sa bon hūm̐ mthing las gyur pa'i// gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mtshan las// 'od 'phros dgra bgegs bsgral zhing 'phags rnams mchod// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i// bdag nyid bcom ldan zil gnon tshe yi bdag

/'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa ni// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// mthing nag g.yas zhal dkar zhing ha hā bzhad// g.yon dmar 'khrugs shing rak+ta'i rba klong 'phyo// dbus zhal mthing nag rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog /spyan dgu dus mtha'i me 'bar bzhin du 'khrugs// dbu skra kham nag gyen 'khyil smin ma dang*// sma ra ag tshom bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje dang*// g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub bsgrengs// zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyad kyi dor stabs tshul// sku stod mi lpags glang po'i ko rlon gsol// sku smad stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs steng*// dug sbrul nag po'i ske rags dag gis bcings| /klu gnyan rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze dang*// gdol pa'i rigs kyi sbrul chen dkar ser dmar// nag pos snyan dang mgul chu phyag zhabs dkris// khrag chen thig le zhag gi zo ris dang*// thal chen tshom bu'i sku yi cha rnams spras// bdud srin btsan rgyal ru tra'i thod pa lnga// rin chen rtse bran gyis brgyan dbu gsum brjid// bdud dang dgra bgegs ban bon mu stegs kyi// mgo bcad khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i do shal dang*// sde brgyad mgo bo phreng ba'i mgul rgyan can// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rab tu khro// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan dang dur khrod chas// dpa' rngam ldan pa'i rgyan gyis rab brjid pa'i// dpal chen zil gnon me dpung dbus su 'gyings// sbyor yum gsod byed bdud 'dul rgyal mo yum// mthing nag khro mo gzig gi sham thabs can// spyan gsum thod pa rin chen rus pas spras// ral pa mthing nag rin chen lan phran brgyan// g.yas pas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud// g.yon pas thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stob// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor snyoms 'jug tshul// lhan skyes dga' bde'i ngang du rol zhing rtse// yab kyi thugs kar baṃ chen bsnol ba'i steng*// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa khrag rul mdog

/g.yas g.yon 'khor lo tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnams// tshangs pa'i mgo phreng rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gyings pa'i thugs ka ru// dregs pa phyag rdor ljang nag g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pas tsit+ta rin chen spras pa 'chang*// brkyang bskum stag sham sbrul dang rin chen brgyan// pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs thugs kar srid pa'i lha// rus sbal rngam pa mi zan gser gyi mdog /yan lag lnga la rang byung mchod rten lnga// sme ba khrag dang thig les rab brgyan cing*// mgo bo thur bstan mig gnyis gyen du bltas// srid gsum lto na gnas pa'i ngo bor gsal// gtso bo'i spyi bor bya khyung sku mdog dkar// gser g.yu'i gshog pa phyag gnyis dug sprul za// rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags 'bar ba nyid// de ltar rtsa ba'i lha drug gsal ba'i ngang*// gtso bo'i sku la gyad gnon rgyan gyi lha// phrag gong gnyis su khyung mo smug nag gnyis// dpung pa gnyis su stag mo ro zan re| |nu steng seng ge ral pa sprugs pa gnyis// sta zur dug sbrul dug rlangs 'phyo ba gnyis// de ltar rgyan gyi lha brgyad yongs su rdzogs// gru gsum 'bar ba'i zla gam rnam gsum gyi// mdun du sku sprul tshe bdag sku mdog mthing*// rtsa ba'i zhal gsum khro bo dbus mthing zhal// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar de'i steng dbus ma he// g.yas stag g.yon pa seng ge de'i steng dbus| |khyung dang g.yas pa dur bya g.yon rma bya// bco brgyad phyag rnams mtshon cha 'bar pa thogs// tha mas gnam lcags 'khor lo 'bar ba skor// rak+sha kro dhī dmar mo spu gri dang*// thod khrag thogs nas yab 'khyud seng chen zhon// zla gam g.yas su gsung sprul srog bdag dmar// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum 'bar ba bsgrad// thod pa'i rna cha 'bar bas rab tu brgyan| |g.yas g.yon dang pos bse mdung phur bu thogs// tha gnyis gnam lcags 'khor lo 'bar ba skor// bse khrab gyon zhing bdud mo re ma ti// dmar mo g.yas g.yon spu gri thod khrag thogs// yab dang 'khril sbyor stag chen dar ma zhon// zla gam g.yon du thugs sprul 'chi bdag nag

/sbal nag mgo dgu g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// khram shing sbrul nag 'bar ba'i phyag gnyis kyis// sbal nag nad rkyal tha gnyis gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo bskor bas dgra bgegs tshe srog gcod// dus mtshan dmar mo g.yas g.yon spu gri dang*// thod khrag thogs nas yab la 'khril sbyor tshul// dug sbrul kha nas dug rlangs 'phyo ba zhon// de yi phyi yi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i// shar du srin po ya ma rā dza ni// sku mdog smug nag dur khrod chas kyis brjid// ma traṃ ro dbyug 'khor lo 'bar ba thogs// yum mchog ro langs khrag mdog khram shing dang*// nad rkyal thogs nas dred mong kham nag zhon// lho ru gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba ni// g.yas g.yon be con gnam lcags 'khor lo thogs// gsod byed nag mo khram shing nad rkyal thogs// 'khril sbyor dom nag snying dkar zhon nas 'gying*| |nub tu bdud po ār+ya me ru ni// dmar nag g.yas g.yon be con 'khor lo skor// srog len nag mo khram shing nad rkyal thogs// 'khril sbyor wa mo lto ser chibs su bcibs// byang du gnod sbyin ral pa tshal dgu ljang*// g.yas g.yon be con 'khor lo 'bar ba thogs// bdud mo ral nag ljang nag khram shing dang*// nad rkyal thogs nas yab dang gnyis med 'khril| |drel rta rkang gsum bcibs nas dgra srog gcod// kun kyang mi lpags gyon nas zhing chen khrir// dgra srog gcod cing sgrub po'i bka' sdod tshul// de'i phyir 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs brgyad kyi// phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs steng thod mkhar 'bar ba bzhir// shar du dung gi mon pa seng gdong dkar// lcags kyi ral can g.yas g.yon dgra sta dang*// tsit+ta thogs nas dam nyams tsit+ta 'dren// mon mo bla rkun yum dang mnyam par sbyor// lho ru lcags kyi mon pa stag gdong mthing*// lcags kyi rna rgyan g.yas g.yon dgra sta dang*// tsit+ta thogs nas dgra bo'i dus mtha' stung*// mon mo g.yu yi ral can sku la 'khril// nub tu gser gyi mon pa dred gdong dmar// khrag gi ral can g.yas g.yon dgra sta dang*// tsit+ta thogs nas dgra bo'i srog dbugs phral| |mon mo tshe 'phrog khrag ral can dang sbyor// byang du gser gyi mon pa khyung gdong ser// khyung gi ral can g.yas g.yon dgra sta dang*// tsit+ta thogs nas dgra bo'i bla srog stung*// mon mo snying 'byin gzer 'bebs sku la 'khril// de ltar bla 'gugs pho nya mon pa bzhi// zhe sdang sbrul dang thod pa skam rlon brgyan// zhing chen g.yang gzhi rlon pa'i go zu can// yum rnams lcags kyu zhags pa thogs nas 'khril// dgra bgegs bla srog 'gugs shing dus mtha' sdud// mtsham bzhi'i rtsibs steng lcags mkhar chen mo bzhi// shar lhor he le khyab pa 'chi bdag bdud// tshangs pa'i cha 'dzin sku mdog dmar zhing 'tsher// nag mo mi zan bla rkun yum dang sbyor// lho nub nag po 'dzum med 'chi bdag bdud// bdud kyi cha 'dzin sku mdog gnag cing 'tsher// nag mo snying khrag dug 'thung ma dang sbyor// nub byang so brdar 'khrigs pa 'chi bdag bdud// srin po'i cha 'dzin sku mdog dmar zhing 'khrugs// nag po sha la gzer 'bebs yum dang sbyor// byang shar ral pa spyi bcings 'chi bdag bdud// gnod sbyin cha 'dzin sku mdog ljang nag gsal// ma mo nag mo khrag ral can dang sbyor// yab rnams g.yas g.yon khram shing zhags pa thogs// sku la rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi gsol// yum rnams g.yas g.yon spu gri mi snying thogs// gcer mo mi gdug gzugs 'chang yab la 'khril| |de'i phyir bcu gnyis rtsibs la ni// lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis nang*// shar stod be wa sa ta nag

/shar smad nor bu dge 'phel ser// shar lhor nag po 'joms byed ser| |lho stod bye ba dgu khri nag /lho smad rak+sha glog phreng dmar// lho nub yak+sha gsod byed nag /nub stod gtum po du ba'i mdog /nub smad gang ba kun 'joms dkar// nub byang kham pa ral gcig dmar// byang stod sbrul mgo kun 'dzin sngo// byang smad ngang pa stobs ldan ser// byang shar gyad pa stobs can nag /zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis po// glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon// ha ha hi hi'i sgra sgrog cing*// be con 'khor lo phyag na bsnams// de'i phyir 'obs chen bco brgyad la gnas pa// badz+ra ging kar khams gsum dbang sdud 'khril// rdo rje gnod sbyin lcags kyu 'dren mas 'khril// rdo rje srin po gzugs med rlung rgyus 'khril// rdo rje 'byung po gar gyi glog 'gyus 'khril// rdo rje shwa na rbod gtong len byed 'khril// rdo rje ro langs rna brnyan pha mas 'khril// rdo rje rol byed khams gsum snying 'joms 'khril// rdo rje 'chi bdag tshogs kyi byan mas 'khril// rdo rje dus mtshan gsod pa'i las brtson 'khril// kun kyang rang rtags phyag mtshan 'bar ba thogs// 'obs chen zung re skyong zhing dgra bgegs sgrol// de'i phyir khyams la gshin rje sum cu gnyis// shar du khram thogs bdud nag khros pa brgyad// g.yas pa khram shing g.yon pa 'khor lo bskor// rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta nag rting dkar zhon// lho ru gshin rje chu glang zhon pa brgyad// g.yas pa be con g.yon pa 'khor lo thogs// nub na ma mo dre'u zhon pa brgyad// g.yas g.yon nad rkyal thun zor 'khor lo bsnams// byang du gnod sbyin bya nag zhon pa brgyad// g.yas g.yon ral gri dang ni zhags pa thogs// de ltar zhag gi gshin rje sum cu gnyis// rang rtags rgyan dang ldan pa'i sku ru gyur// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi legs skyong ba// shar sgor dkar po snying 'byin dkar zhing 'tsher// lho sgor ma hā kā lā brjid pa'i gzugs// nub sgor bdud po yab rje nag po dang*// byang sgor gnod sbyin sku mchog dmar po rnams// thun khrag 'khor lo rkyal pa phyag na bsnams// sku la ber nag 'jigs pa dgu brtsegs gsol// de bzhi'i yum mchog khro mo ro langs bzhi// g.yas pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ro yi dbyug pa bsnams// g.yon rnams lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang*// dril bu bsnams nas yab dang 'khril sbyor mdzad// sgo bzhi legs skyong bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol// phyi yi mu ran 'khor yug chen po la// za ma'i gshin rje dreg byed pho mo'i tshogs// pho gshin mo gshin sum brgya drug cu re// gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu'i tshogs rnams dang*// gzhan yang sha za drug khri drug stong tshogs// khrag 'thung 'bar ba sa ya'i tshogs rnams dang*// lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag gi tshogs// grangs med char sprin 'khrigs ltar mngon sum gyur// bzhi pa spyan drang ba ni/

gtso 'khor gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐// dkar dmar nag dang khyad par gtso bo yi// thugs kar hūm̐ dang yum gyi snying gar ma// ya ma'i thugs kar ya dang dregs pa yi// thugs kar hūm̐ dang rus sbal thugs kar e// bya khyung thugs kar khroṃ rnams gsal ba las| |'od 'phros 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// 'jam dpal khros pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med kyis bskor nas// skad cig spyan drangs dam tshigs pa la thim// zhes mos la/ e/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa na// gru gsum mthing nag e yi gzhal yas nas// yab gcig 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon dang*// gnyis med yum chen gsod byed rgyal mor bcas// dad pa dam tshigs dbang gis spyan 'dren na// thugs rje che ldan gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol| |'jam dpal rtsa ba'i lha drug gshegs su gsol// khro bo rgyan gyi lha brgyad gshegs su gsol// sku gsung thugs sprul rnam gsum gshegs su gsol// gshed chen sde bzhi yab yum gshegs su gsol// bla 'gugs mon pa yab yum gshegs su gsol// bdud chen yab yum rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol// zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol// sgrol ging yab yum bco brgyad gshegs su gsol// zhag gi gshin rje so gnyis gshegs su gsol// sgo skyong pho nya rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol// phyi 'khor dregs pa'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dur khrod yi dwags 'bar ba'i khri steng du// klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong khri dang*// phyogs skyong ma he pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// 'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po bzhugs su gsol// zil gnon sku yi dkyil 'khor khyon yangs par// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i lha chen rnam pa lnga// khro bo gyad gnon rgyan gyi lha brgyad rnams// mi g.yo dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po'i rtsibs chen phyi nang dang*// 'obs chen sgo bzhir bcas pa'i gnas mchog tu// dgra bgegs gnod byed gdug pa'i khri steng du// gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

drug pa dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ e/ bdag nyid ye nas chos kyi sku// rang rtsal 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// sprul pa rtsa ba gyad gnon bcas// ye nas dbang bskur ngang gis grub// bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon gyi// dbu rgyan thod skam lnga lnga'i nang*// spyi bor bud+dha he ru kaḥ /smug nag 'khor lo thod khrag thogs// de bzhin khros pa'i rgyal mos 'khril// dpral bar badz+ra he ru kaḥ |mthing nag rdo rje thod khrag thogs// badz+ra khros pa'i rgyal mos 'khril// ltag g.yas rat+na he ru kaḥ /ser nag rin chen thod khrag bsnams// rat+na khros pa'i rgyal mos 'khril// ltag khung pad+ma he ru kaḥ /dmar nag pad+ma thod khrag thogs// pad+ma khros pa'i rgyal mos 'khril// ltag g.yon karma he ru kaḥ /ljang nag ral gri thod khrag thogs// karma khros pa'i rgyal mos 'khril| |yum rnams sku mdog yab mtshungs shing*// tri shū la dang thod khrag thogs// yab yum dur khrod chas ldan gsal// steng du kun bzang yab dang yum// 'khril sbyor rgyan med mthing gsal mdog /yab kyis rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub la// yum gyis tri shūl thod khrag thogs// bdag gis hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas// sgo gsum rdo rje rgya gram dang*// slar yang tsakra hūm̐ brjod pas// sgo dgu 'khor lo 'bar ba re// rgyas gdab srung zhing go char gyur// ces mos// bdun pa dam tshig gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ shin tu mos pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing*| |dad pa mchog gis lha mchog khyod mi gtong*// 'gro la phan phyir lha mchog khyod bsgrub na// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa dang*// yab yum 'bar ba'i sku mchog brtan du gsol| |khro rgyal yab yum sku dang mnyam sbyor nas// sangs rgyas zhing du lha khyod bdag bsgrub na// khro gdug dregs byed 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// phrin las rdzogs par mdzod cig de nyid las// 'das na dam can khyod kyi dam tshig tshogs// nyams par 'gyur gyi de dag dgongs mdzod la// dus 'dir phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ hoḥ

zhes brjod/ brgyad pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ chos sku skye med rol pa'i mkha' dbyings las// longs sku 'gag med thugs rje'i cho 'phrul ston// sprul pa'i sku mchog phyag rgya zil gnon gsal// rtsa ba'i lha drug gyad gnon bcas la 'dud// sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi yab yum bcas// mon pa yab yum bdud chen yab yum dang*// 'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgrol ging yab yum dgu/ gshin rje so gnyis sgo skyong yab yum bcas// dregs pa 'khor dang bcas par phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes brjod/ dgu pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal thugs rje che ldan khros pa'i sku// khro bo'i rgyal po phyag rgya zil gnon dang*// sprul 'khor dregs byed dmag tshogs bcas pa la// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams// mchod yon me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri chab zhal zas rnga dung rol mo'i sgra// stong gsum srid pa bkang ste bdag 'bul na// dgyes par dgongs la khyod kyis myur bzhes nas// mchog thun 'bras bu stsol cig gshin rje'i gshed// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dbul/ bcu pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ e/ dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral ba yi// snying mig rna ba sna dang lce// dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di// 'bul gyi dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /ya ma rā dza puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen dang*// rkang dang klad pa gu gul bcas// dur khrod sol chen mer bsregs pa// snoms la sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig /ya ma rā dza dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi rkang dang tshil// zhun chen 'bar ba'i rgya mtsho ru// ras chen sdong bu'i mar me ru// 'bul gyi phrin las mngon du gyis// ya ma rā dza dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

dgra gegs bsgral ba'i mkhris pa dang*// dri chu chu ser rab sbyar ba'i// ga pur sbags pa'i dri chab 'di// byugs la bka' dang bstan pa srungs// ya ma rā dza gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ dgra dang bgegs kyi sha rus rkang*// 'bru nag ngar phye dug khrag gis// sbrus pa'i bshos gtsang brjid ldan 'di// bzhes la 'khor dang gang zag skyongs// ya ma rā dza nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ thod rnga ltag sprod rkang gling dang*// gsang ba'i rnga chung la sogs dang*// sngags sgra 'brug stong ldir mtshungs pa// gson la dpal dang grags pa sgrubs// ya ma rā dza shapad pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bcu gcig pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya rnam pa lnga// gzugs sgra dri ro reg byas nyer mdzes shing*// 'dod pa'i rgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir mkhas pa// zhi ba'i ngang las khro mor sprul byas nas// phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// khyod thugs so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*// chags bral snyoms 'jug dga' bde'i rol gar gyis// bde stong lhan skyes ngang du rtag bzhugs nas// bdag dang dgra bgegs 'gro drug 'khor ba'i rgyu// 'dod chags me me dpung rtsad nas rab bcad de// sor rtogs ye shes ngang du grol bar mdzod// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a nu rā ga ya pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bcu gnyis pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i ngo bo dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i chos nyid rnams| |snang stong grag stong tshor stong myong stong dang*// reg stong gdod nas dag pa'i rnam rol nyid// lha dang bdag nyid 'khor ba myang 'das can// dbyer med yod med mtha' bral ngang du grol| |tha dad med pa'i chos nyid mnyam pa nyid// deng 'dir mchod pa rmad byung dam pa ste// 'jam mgon khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pū dza mū la dharma kā ya pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/

zhes dang*/ bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ chos sman gyis sbags pa'i bdud rtsi srin lag gis thigs gtor gyis mchod cing*/ hūm̐ */ rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i ra sa yān// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bcud kyi mchog /'bru yi chang dang bcos pa'i myos byed sogs// sbyar zhing sbyangs spel sbar ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// 'jam dpal mchog dang rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// dbyer med mchog gi zhal du mchod pa 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// shan+tiṃ gar+bha khrag 'thung nag po dang*// gtsug lag dpal dge ba su dha ra dang*// sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du mchod pa 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gter ston zhang khrom lcags thun nag po dang*// gnubs ston chos grags gnubs chen bya bral dang*// badz+ra rā dza dharma kīrti dang*// chos kyi blo gros zhal du mchod pa 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho grags pa'i mtshan// sngags 'chang chen po bdud 'joms rdo rje dang*// bka' drin zla bral sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lcags sdig rang gzhung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phul zhing*/ slar yang yi dam rnams la 'bul ba ni/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su// 'jam dpal khros pa phyag rgya zil gnon la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/

khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku yi dkyil 'khor na// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnam pa drug /khro rgyal gyad gnon rgyan gyi lha brgyad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ sku gsung thugs sprul rnam gsum yum dang bcas| |gshed chen 'bar ba sde bzhi yum dang bcas// bla 'gugs mon pa bdud bzhi yum dang bcas// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ zla ba'i 'chi bdag chen po bcu gnyis dang*// sgrol ging yab yum 'bar ba bco brgyad dang*// zhag gi gshin rje so gnyis sgo ba bzhir// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dkyil 'khor phyi yi 'khor yug la gnas pa'i// pho gshin mo gshin sha za drug cu tshogs// lha srin sde brgyad gshin rje ma mo'i bdag /bka' sdod las mkhan 'jig rten dregs tshogs la| |rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes phul la/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hoḥ sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang*// dkar dmar mthing gi yig 'bru gsum gyis gtams// mtheb srin nyi zla 'bar ba'i 'od kyis drangs// ljags su bstar bas sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// 'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas// lha mchog khyod dang smon lam gcig pa'i mthus// da lta zhal mthong yi dam lhar gsal zhing*// snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshe// tshe rabs 'khor ba gar gnas gar skyes kyang*// rjes su zung zhig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// dngos grub stsol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// bar chad sol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// dgra bgegs sgrol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/

sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod la/ mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi lce thog tu myong*/ bcu bzhi pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ rak+ta sbreng zhing*/ hūm̐ */ lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha yangs pa ru// gdug pa ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang*// dam nyams ban bon bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang*// dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po bsgral ba'i khrag /bi ṣa bye ba dgu yis rab sbags shing*| |myos byed dbu ba'i bde bas nyer spras pa'i// yum chen mkha' gsang rgyu gnyis las byung zhing*// dmar mo gī ti gsang ba'i rak+ta dang*// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtsa ba'i rak+ta dang*// mkha' dbyings las byung pad+ma rak+ta ste// de ltar rkyen gsum phrad pa las byung ba'i// nyon mongs kun 'joms rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon khro bo'i rgyal// rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang*// sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi mon pa bdud// 'chi bdag sgrol ging gshin rje sgo skyong tshogs// lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du 'bul// las ngan 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur dgra bgegs kyi// nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad nas rab bcad nas// chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog /oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes brjod/ bco lnga pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ gtor mar sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs su// 'bru nag sna dgu ngar phye byas pa dag /gdug pa'i dug dang dgra bgegs mgo bcad pa'i// srog rtsa'i khrag gis sbags pa'i gtor chen la// mdzes pa'i dkar thig dmar gyi gur phub cing*// sha chen glo snying 'phan gdugs ltar sbrengs pa'i| |'dod yon lnga ldan dpal gyi gtor ma 'di// phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// zhe sdang rus dang 'dod chags rak+ta'i rgyun// gti mug sha dang nga rgyal mkhris pa dang*| |phrag dog glo snying nang khrol rgyu ma'i tshogs// dug lnga'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// gzhan yang phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i dam rdzas dang*| |glu dbyangs mkho dgu'i longs spyod 'byor pa dang*// dam nyams dgra bgegs dbugs dang bla srog yid// sha khrag klad rus rkang dang khu ba zhag

/nang khrol don snying so sen pags la sogs| |lus ngag yid gsum 'bul gyi myur bzhes la// bcol ba'i 'bras bu myur du smin par mdzod// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba ling+ta/ rak+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ bo dhi tsit+ta/ ma traṃ ru tra kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dbul/ slar yang a+yai ring gi mjug tu/ dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi sha la khā hi/ khrag la khā hi/ rus pa la khā hi/ klad pa la khā hi/ rkang dang khu ba la khā hi/ zhag dang chu ser la khā hi/ don snod 'khor dang bcas pa la khā hi/ skra sen pags pa dang bcas pa la khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam/ nyer gcig gam/ bdun gyis 'bul lo// bcu drug pa phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥ 'jam dpal khros pa phyag rgya zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug /rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa rnam gsum/ gshed chen sde bzhi/ bla 'gugs kyi mon pa bzhi/ zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis| sgrol ging chen po bco brgyad/ zhag gi gshin rje sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sgo skyong rnam pa bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje/ 'khor yug skyong ba pho gshed sum brgya drug cu/ mo gshed sum brgya drug cu/ gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu/ sha za drug khri drug stong*/ khrag 'thung bye ba sa ya/ lha ma srin sde brgyad/ dregs byed 'bar ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag dam can sgrub pa po'i phyi nang gsang ba'i sman raka gtor ma'i dngos po dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi 'byor pas mchod cing phul ba'i mthus/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bzod par gsol gyi bzhes la tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub dam pa stsol ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la 'jig rten mthong ba'i chos 'di la tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang grags pa/ longs spyod/ mnga' thang*/ chos dang srid kyi rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig /lha mchog 'bar ba khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bla na ma mchis pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyu dang skal pa gang lags pa de nyid da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol/

phrin las su bcol ba ni/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs gzugs liṅga dang ming yi ge/ skye mched dang*/ rus bla dwags mtshan ma byang dmar gyi dkyus la btab pa 'di/ mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs// nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzug /skye 'chi gnyis ma khungs ma g.yor/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la bsnyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gyang*/ skyug par gyis/ yid 'khrugs par gyis/ srog dang phrol/ sa ma ya/ ma gtong zhig /ma shor zhig /ming dang ming ma nor/ bla dang bla ma nor/ rus dang rus ma nor bar myur du bzhes shig /med par gyis shig /brlag par gyis shig /phung bar gyis shig /dgu rgyud rtsad nas chod cig /pho rgyud rus pa gting nas chod cig /mo rgyud rak+ta mngal nas skoms shig |rtsa ba dgu rgyud rlung la bskur cig /da lta nyid du rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston par mdzod cig /sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ zhes brjod cing*/ phrin las skabs su gang bab bcol zhing dmod pa 'dor bar bya'o| |bcu bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings stong nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// snying rje'i rang rtsal thogs med khros pa'i sku// 'jam dpal thugs rje che ldan rab khros pa// phyag rgya zil gnon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar klu 'bum gnyan khris mchod// dbus zhal mthing rngam sa bdag kun gyis bstod| |lha srin sde brgyad rje la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'dzin// g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub sdig /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis bsgyings// che btsan 'gran zla bral la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbu skra kham nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga lngas dbu la brgyan| /rin chen rtse bran dar gyi cod pan pur// rgyal bas dbang bskur khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// klu gnyan rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze dmangs// gdol ba'i rigs mtshon dkar ser dmar ljang nag

/bum sna can lngas sku dang yan lag brgyan// dug can 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku stod sprin mgrin so ldan g.yang gzhi gsol// sku smad dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs steng*// dug 'dzin nag po'i ske rags mdzes par bcings// dpa' gtum khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgo rlon khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i do shal can// zhal gsum cher gdangs drag sngags dbyar skyes rnga// ljags 'gyur phyogs brgyar g.yo ba'i mjug brgya pa// mche ba bcu gnyis bsil ri 'bar bas gtams// gdug pa'i klad khrag 'gems byed khyod la bstod| |rin chen rus rgyan dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// bskal pa'i me klong klu 'bum gnyan khri dang*// sa bdag stong phrag phyogs skyong ma he brgyad// chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan la 'gying bag gis| |gar dgu'i rol pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal gyi spyi bor mkha' lding lcags bse dang gser gyi mon pa bzhi// ral can stag dang dred mo dkar rmigs bu'i// gdong can bla 'gugs mon pa bzhi la bstod// he le khyab pa nag po 'dzum med dang*// so brdar 'khrigs pa ral pa spyi bcings bzhi// tshangs pa bdud dang srin po gnod sbyin gyi// cha 'dzin bdud chen yab yum bzhi la bstod// de'i phyir 'khor rtsibs 'bar ba bcu gnyis na// zla ba'i 'chi bdag chen po bcu gnyis tshogs// dgra bgegs 'gugs dang gsod pa'i las byed pa// 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// de'i phyir 'obs chen bco brgyad legs skyong ba'i// las byed sgrol ba'i ging chen yab yum dgus// srid gsum sgrol zhing 'obs chen zung re skyong*// sgrol ging chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// dkyil 'khor chen po'i khyams chen la rol ba// khram thogs bdud dang gshin rje ma mo dang*// gnod sbyin brgyad brgyad rang rtags mtshon cha thogs// zhag gi gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dkar po snying 'byin ma hā kā lā dang*| |yab rje nag po gnod sbyin 'bar ba bzhi// phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams srung zhing bar chad sel// sgo srung dregs pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi rol 'khor yug chen po la gnas pa'i| |pho gshed mo gshed gshin rje sha za dang*// khrag 'thung dregs pa sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs// za ma'i dregs byed 'bar ba'i tshogs la bstod// chos nyid mnyam yangs nang gi byed pa las| |rang mdangs ma 'gag shar ba gshin rje'i gshed// de yi rang rtsal sna tshogs dregs pa'i dmag

/rang byung rang shar tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// srung zlog bsad mnan drag po'i phrin las mdzod// ma thogs skad cig 'grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// bdag 'dod 'bras bu myur du smin par mdzod// ces dang*/ gru gsum mthing nag mas kyang bstod do// spro na skabs 'dir lcags sdig smad kyi gnyer ma gsum las chad pa'i chos sde'i bstod pa dang*/ bskul che 'bring chung gsum yang bya'o// bco brgyad pa bzlas pa bya ba ni gnyis las/ dang po a+yai ring bzla bar 'dod na/ rang gi thugs kar rus sbal rngam pa mi zan gyi thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che 'od kyi ga'u nang du hūm̐ mthing nag /de'i klad kor gyi nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma/ khog par rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig tu gsal zhing*/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i nang du a ya ma du ru tsa sha na zhes pa'i 'bru brgyad steng nas rim gyis brtsegs par hūm̐ gi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ma dang*/ 'og tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yas mtshan pa/ de dag gi mtha' skor du a+yai ring 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe de las 'od kyi sne la rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje nas 'bru tsam gyis gang bar ra gur lta bu'i dra mig thams cad khro chung mthing nag be con dang tsit+ta bsnams pas gang zhing*/ sngags kyi 'od zer las phyi rol du/ 'khor lo rtsibs stong rno dbal dang ldan pa gnyis las/ gcig g.yas su 'khor bas klu gnyan sa bdag dgra bgegs thams cad dmyal dmyal gtub pa/ de'i nang du bsrung bya thams cad tshud pa/ bdag zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga /phyag rdor gyi thugs kar hūm̐/ ya ma rā dza'i thugs kar ya dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar ma dang*/

bya khyung gi thugs kar khroṃ rnams las/ a+yai ring rang rang gi mdog can gyis bskor ba/ bdag gis a+yai ring bzlas pa'i tshe rtsa ba'i lha drug gi zhal nas drag sngags a+yai ring me'i rang bzhin du 'phro zhing so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon las khro chung phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba| de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing*/ mkhyen brtse dang byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus nas sa bon la thim/ slar yang 'od zer mtshon cha lta bu dgra bgegs byad ma la phog pas de dag lha srung dang bcas pa bsgral nas nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus bdag la thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ zil gnon gyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'od 'phros pas/ srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du 'khor lo mtshon cha me ri'i gur khang gi phyi rol du phyi byang chub mchod rten la/ nang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi la khro bo mthing nag /g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ g.yon 'khor lo bsnams pa re res srung ba dang*/ bdag gis sngags bzlas pa'i tshe lha tshogs thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrog par gyur par bsam pa'i ngang nas/ a+yai a+yai a+yai a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma ye oṃ/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye āḥ hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ a ā ne ā ne/ u ū ne ū ne/ du dū ne dū ne/ a i/ u e/ o aṃ/ ra rī/ la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sidha ye/ hri ta ye/ bhi ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu kha ye/ u u ne/ u u ne/ bi kṛ tā/ a a na na/ ya ma rā tsa/ ya ma rak+sha/ ya ma rak+ṣa/ ya ma raka a/ be ta lī/ kro dhī shwa rī/ ma ma e ka tsa ti/ dhe ma kā lī baṃ ril/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī badz+ra kro dha ya ma karma ro ṣa ṇa/ kro dha tsaṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa mon+ta āḥhūm̐ dza/ zhes pa stong srog gi bsnyen pa ni rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shigs pa'i sku bskyed ste a+yai ring rnal ma rang lugs su bzla ba zhes bshad pa'i don yin la/

'di'i bsnyen tshad ni lcags sdig bad kan yol ba dang*/ mchod rten sgron me rgyas pa gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ a+yai ring 'bum phrag gsum du bzla// de yis lus sbyong lus lhar 'grub// bsnyen pa bsam gtan phur gcig brtan| |bsam gtan lus kyi sgron ma'o// zhes pa ltar/ 'bum phrag gsum du nges par bya zhing*/ rtags dang sbyar la bya'o// 'di'i dgos ched de nyid las/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa med gyur na// lha rnams yongs su nye mi nus// de phyir lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs// bsam gtan lha nyid bsgom par bya// bsam pa brtan po gsal ba dang*// e la sngags bskor a+yai ring bzla// phyag rgya zil gnon bsam gtan no// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// 'di ni phyi a+yai ring rnal ma'i dmigs pa yin gyi gzhan nang a+yai ring zlog pa/ gsang ba a+yai ring dkrugs la bzla ba/ yang gsang a+yai ring dmar len 'bru gshag spel mar bzla ba/ gzhan yang lcags thag dgu sbrel gyi gdams pa rnams dang*/ gzir zhing stobs bshig byas pa bshig /zug pa dbyung dang gsang lam dgag /zlog dang gnan pa'i spyang mo drug /ces pa la sogs ni phrin las so so'i skabs su rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar dmigs pa dang*/ sngags dang*/ rdzas dang*/ 'khor lo sogs kyi 'khrul 'khor bca' ba ni sdig pa'i chos sde las rtogs par bya'o// de nas yang a+yai ring gi bzlas pa dang*/ a+ye thung gang mos spel mar bya 'dod na/ a+ye thung gi dmigs pa ni/ rus sbal rngam pa mi zan gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar| a+ye thung gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro ba'i don byas/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/ 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor dgra bgegs rnams kyi mthu rtsal nus pa thams cad bsdus te rang la thim par bsams la/

a+ye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong khri 'dzab tu bzla zhes pa ni/ lcags sdig mgo bo gru gsum las byung ba'i sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po las bshad do// de ltar na a+yai ring stong srog dang*/ a+ye thung gnyis ka grangs tshad drod rtags thon par bya ba shin tu gnad che bar snang ngo*// yang skabs su/ e ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya ā/ zhes sku'i sngags yig 'bru bcu gsum pa dang*/ a+ye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes gsung gi sngags yig 'bru bco lnga pa dang*/ a+ye myag ya rngub mug shag ka dun/ zhes thugs kyi sngags 'bru brgyad pa rnams kyang bzla zhing lcags sdig gi las mtha' phal cher thugs kyi sngags a+ye myag la brten pa mang bas 'di la nan cher bya dgos so// de nas mjug gi cho ga ni/ tshogs byin gyis brlab pa/ spyan drang ba/ dang po mchod pa/ bar pa thugs dam bskang zhing bshags pa/ tha ma 'gugs pa dang*/ lha dang phral ba/ bsgral zhing dbul ba/ longs spyod pa/ lhag ma'i cho ga /dam can spyir bskul zhing*/ pho nya dgos su mngag pa/ zor 'phang ba/ brtan ma bskyang ba/ rta bro/ bshags pa/ smon lam/ gshegs bsdu/ bkra shis te rnam grangs bcu dgu las/ dang po tshogs kyi yo byad 'du byas la/ chus bran te/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid dpal chen zil gnon thugs srog las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyi yi ge gsum 'phros pas// raṃ las me byung tshogs kyi 'bag btsog bsregs// yaṃ las rlung byung dngos 'dzin dri ma sbyangs// khaṃ las chu byung bag chags ngan pa bkrus// tshogs kyi dngos po ma dag longs spyod rnams// gtsang dag dri ma bral ba'i dngos por gyur// ces dang*/ slar sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sa bon las// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥ'aphros pas// oṃ yig dkar gsal las byung sku rdo rje// zhe sdang gnas 'joms chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// dkar gsal mu tig chen po lta bur gyur// āḥyig dmar po las byung gsung rdo rje// 'dod chags gnas 'joms longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// dmar chen pad+ma rā ga'i phung po ltar// hūm̐ yig mthing ga las byung thugs rdo rje// gti mug kun dag sprul pa sku yi dngos// mthing gsal in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs ltar gyur// brjod pa ha yis ro drug nus pa sbyangs/

hoḥyis mang por spel zhing ro brgya ldan// hrīḥyis sbar bas 'chi med bdud rtsir gyur// 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mdzes pa 'di// longs spyod stong khams mnyam pa'i ngo bor gyur// ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ byin rlabs rmad byung thugs rje'i gter ldan zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi rang gzugs rnams// gcig tu bstan pa rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon khro bo'i rgyal// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// mkha' lding khyung sogs rtsa ba'i lha rnams dang*// gyad gnon lha brgyad sprul pa rnam gsum sogs// gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// phyi 'khor mu ran bde bar skyong ba yi// zil gnon bka' sdod dregs pa lha srin sogs// sde brgyad dregs byed 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs la/ gsum pa tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// zil gnon yab yum 'khor dang bcas// bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs rnams la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// 'dod pa'i yod tan rgya chen rnams// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas ni// khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dam nyams dgra bgegs bla dbugs srog /sha khrag rkang dang khu bar bcas// mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa rnams| |zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bzhi pa tshogs bar pas bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jam mgon khros pa'i khro rgyal tshogs// 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs rnams dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi// gshin rje 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dgra bo'i dbugs dang bla srog mdangs// tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod dang*// snyan grags mkho dgu'i rdzas dang bcas// zil gnon khro bo'i thugs dam bskang*// dam rdzas dgra bo'i sha dang khrag

/klad rus rkang dang khu bar bcas| |dri chu zhag dang nang khrol tshogs// skra sen pags pa'i longs spyod kyis// khro rgyal 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ */gtor zor thun rdzas phur bu gri// mtshon cha sna tshogs drag po'i rdzas| |mnan gtad sreg zor 'phang ba'i rdzas// dam rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan skongs la// bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mi mthun dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dpal chen yab yum 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas| |da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du// khro rgyal khyod nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung yang*// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'i las| |rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa dang*// nor 'khrul 'dod sred phongs dang ser sna yis// bsgribs gyur bdag blo 'khrul par gang gyur pa// gnong 'gyod sems kyis mthol zhing bshags bgyi na// bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub kyi// sgrib med 'bras bu mchog rnams deng stsol cig /ces dang*/ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya sogs brjod la/ lnga pa tshogs tha ma'i bsgral mchod ni/ dgra bo'i zag rdzas sogs kyis sbags pa'i liṅga dmar po ming rus bcug pa mdun du bzhag la/ dgug gzhug gsum gyi mjug tu/ e/ zil gnon 'bar ba'i bka' 'khor nas/ */ shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub nam gyi gung thun la// dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi// bla 'khyams ma shor khrid la shog /lho yi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub nam gyi gung thun la// dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi| |bla 'khyams ma shor khrid la shog

/nub kyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub nam gyi gung thun la// dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi// bla 'khyams ma shor khrid la shog /byang gi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub nam gyi gung thun la| |dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi// bla 'khyams ma shor khrid la shog /bh+yoḥ bla 'gugs las kyi mon pa bzhi// ma 'gor myur du rgyug la shog /bla 'khyams 'phyo ba'i dus drug la// bla gshed pho nya 'bar ba yis// myur du khug la gzugs 'dir phob// dgra bo'i bla rtags brgyad po la// pho nya brgyad du sprul gyis la// ma shor ma gtong khug la shog /da lta'i gzugs liṃ rten la phog /myur du khug cig dregs pa'i tshogs// lcags kyu 'bar bas myos su chug /tho ba 'bar bas brla dpung chom// dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di// khug cig sod cig mā ra ya// zhes brjod cing bla 'gugs kyi sngags brjod/ drug pa lha dang phral ba ni/ bya rog 'ug pa'i dang rus liṅga byab cing*/ hūm̐ */ nyin gyi pho nya kaṃ ka ma// mtshan gyi pho nya ul+lu ma// khyod gnyis zil gnon thugs las sprul// dgra bo'i lha dang dbye ba'i lha// dus la bab bo mthu ma chung*// dam nyams 'di yi pho lha dang*// yul lha srog lha zhang lha dang*// ma lha ban bon srung ma dang*// bang lha la sogs skyob byed lha// dbang thang lha tshogs sum cu gnyis// myur du phrol la gshin rje yi// gsod byed bdud kyi lag tu sprod// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ lha dang dbye ba'i sngags kyis phral la/ bdun pa bsgral ba ni/ phur bu dang thun dang mtshon cha thogs te/ hūm̐ e zil gnon sprul pa'i lha// sku stod khro bo chen po la// sku smad lcags phur zur gsum 'bar// phyag gnyis gnam lcags phur bu sgril// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir// dam nyams bla srog gnas su 'debs// sgril zhing sgril zhing btab pa na// tshangs dang brgya byin tshogs rnams kyang*// khrag tu skyug cing lus sems 'bral// dam nyams khyod la smos ci dgos// phur bu drag po rab gzir zhing*// thun rdzas tshogs kyis brab pa'i tshe// khyod kyi dug lnga dug gsum tshogs// 'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen rtsad nas chod// rno mtshon 'bar ba'i gri lcags kyis// mgo lus dum bur gtub tsa na// zhe sdang gdug sems gzhi rtsa bcad// khro rgyal khyod kyi sprul pa che// rdo rje phur bu khro chen dang*// de las sprul pa'i khro chung rnams// thun rdzas dug dang nad kyi tshogs// mtshon cha 'bar ba rab thogs pa'i// khro chung tshogs kyis stong gsum gang*| |dus la bab bo dgra bgegs 'di'i// dug lnga 'khor ba'i rtsa ba chod// sod cig sgrol cig ma shor bar// phrin las drag po grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa|

ces bla srog gnad du dbab cing thun brab/ slar yang*/ a+yai ring 'byung ba'i spu gri'i sham can gyi drag sngags dang bcas pas gri lcags kyis dum bur gtub bo// brgyad pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ zil gnon khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs// chos nyid snying rje zhi ba yi// dbyings las drag po'i sku bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes shig /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags skyod cig /'brug sgra lta bu'i nga ro sgrog /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i tshems gtsigs la// dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs// bsad bcad bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// nang khrol dbang po khu ba rkang*/ /zhag dang chu ser pags pa tshil| |so dang sen mo la sogs pa// cung zad tsam yang ma lus pa// khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa yi// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li// dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya// dam nyams bsgral ba'i phung po 'di// zil gnon khros pa'i lha la 'bul// sha ni dbus mthing rngam la 'bul// dgra bo'i gti mug rgyun chod la// chos sku skye med don rtogs nas| |thugs kyi go 'phang thob par mdzod// rus pa g.yas dkar bzhad la 'bul// dgra bo'i zhe sdang rgyun chod la// sprul sku 'gag med don rtogs nas// sku yi go 'phang thob par mdzod| |khrag ni g.yon dmar gshe la 'bul// dgra bo'i 'dod chags rgyun chod la// longs sku chags med don rtogs nas// gsung gi go 'phang thob par mdzod// nang khrol la sogs ma lus pa// lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas par 'bul// dug lnga'i rtsa ba rgyud chod la// mya ngan 'das pa'i sa ru skyol// zil gnon go 'phang thob par mdzod// ces dang*| a+yai ring gi sham du/ ma hā maṃ sa sogs btags la 'bul lo// dgu pa longs spyod pa ni/ tshogs rdzas spros la/ slob dpon dang mched lcam yongs la drangs shing*/ las kyi rdo rjes/ hoḥ zil gnon pha 'bab lhag ma'i tshogs// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha dang khrag

/bram ze gdol pa khyi phag bcas// chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang du rol// ces drangs/ slob dpon mched lcam dang bcas pas/ hoḥ gtsang dang mi gtsang la sogs pa| |gnyis su 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'ching*//
